units.zh: 計劃旅行 Planning a Trip

words.ex_en: This five-star restaurant is famous for its terrific steaks.
words.ex_zh: 這家五星級餐廳以好吃的牛排聞名。
words.ex_blank: This five-star restaurant is famous for its ____ steaks.
words.ex2_en: We had a terrific time exploring the old town together.
words.ex2_zh: 我們一起探索舊城區，玩得非常盡興。
words.ex2_blank: We had a ____ time exploring the old town together.
words.ex3_en: The view from the mountain top was absolutely terrific.
words.ex3_zh: 從山頂看到的景色簡直棒極了。
words.ex3_blank: The view from the mountain top was absolutely ____.

words.ex_en: Through this commercial, we can reach people around the globe.
words.ex_zh: 透過這支廣告，我們就能讓全世界的人認識我們。
words.ex_blank: Through this commercial, we can reach people around ____.
words.ex_grammar: around the globe＝全世界各地，是很常用的旅遊／新聞用語，等於 around the world。
words.ex2_en: Students from around the globe come to study at this university.
words.ex2_zh: 來自世界各地的學生都到這所大學求學。
words.ex2_blank: Students from around ____ come to study at this university.
words.ex3_en: The band's music has fans all over the globe.
words.ex3_zh: 這個樂團的音樂在世界各地都有粉絲。
words.ex3_blank: The band's music has fans all over ____.

words.ex_en: The detective didn't investigate the petty theft in depth.
words.ex_zh: 該警探並沒有深入調查這起小竊盜案。
words.ex_blank: The detective didn't investigate the petty theft ____.
words.ex2_en: We need to discuss this plan in depth before making a decision.
words.ex2_zh: 我們得先深入討論這個計畫，再做決定。
words.ex2_blank: We need to discuss this plan ____ before making a decision.
words.ex3_en: The tour guide explained the temple's history in depth.
words.ex3_zh: 導遊詳細地解說了這座寺廟的歷史。
words.ex3_blank: The tour guide explained the temple's history ____.

words.ex_en: The politicians are out to change the education system in their country.
words.ex_zh: 政治人物們試圖改變他們國家的教育體系。
words.ex_blank: The politicians ____ change the education system in their country.
words.ex2_en: Alex and Belle are out to prove that they can travel around the world.
words.ex2_zh: 艾力克斯和貝兒試圖證明他們能環遊世界。
words.ex2_blank: Alex and Belle ____ prove that they can travel around the world.
words.ex3_en: Some companies are out to attract younger travelers with cheaper tours.
words.ex3_zh: 有些公司試圖用比較便宜的行程吸引年輕旅客。
words.ex3_blank: Some companies ____ attract younger travelers with cheaper tours.
words.grammar: be out to + 原形動詞，表示「一心想要、試圖去做某事」，be 要隨主詞變化（am/is/are/was/were）。

words.ex_en: It took the mountain-climbing group two days to trek across the rainforest.
words.ex_zh: 這個登山團隊花了兩天跋涉橫越這片雨林。
words.ex_blank: It took the mountain-climbing group two days to ____ across the rainforest.
words.ex2_en: We're planning to trek through Southeast Asia for three months.
words.ex2_zh: 我們計畫花三個月的時間在東南亞徒步旅行。
words.ex2_blank: We're planning to ____ through Southeast Asia for three months.
words.ex3_en: Eddie encountered a rattlesnake when he was trekking through the desert.
words.ex3_zh: 艾迪在穿越沙漠長途跋涉時遇到響尾蛇。
words.ex3_blank: Eddie encountered a rattlesnake when he was ____ through the desert.
words.grammar: trek 是規則動詞，但字尾要重複子音字母再加 -ed/-ing：trek → trekked → trekking。

words.ex_en: The hot spring was quite relaxing and washed away Sam's troubles.
words.ex_zh: 這溫泉令人相當放鬆，也把山姆的煩惱洗滌一空。
words.ex_blank: The hot spring was quite ____ and washed away Sam's troubles.
words.ex2_en: Balance your hard traveling with stays at relaxing beaches.
words.ex2_zh: 用悠閒放鬆的海灘假期，來平衡辛苦的旅程。
words.ex2_blank: Balance your hard traveling with stays at ____ beaches.
words.ex3_en: By contrast, living in the country is quite relaxing.
words.ex3_zh: 相比之下，生活在鄉下頗輕鬆的。
words.ex3_blank: By contrast, living in the country is quite ____.
words.grammar: relaxing 形容「讓人感到放鬆的事物」；relaxed 是形容「人本身處於放鬆的狀態」，兩者容易搞混，要注意分辨。

words.ex_en: We made our way to the west coast from Chicago.
words.ex_zh: 我們從芝加哥一路前往西岸。
words.ex_blank: We ____ the west coast from Chicago.
words.ex2_en: After Hong Kong, we'll make our way to Thailand and Vietnam.
words.ex2_zh: 去完香港之後，我們會前往泰國和越南。
words.ex2_blank: After Hong Kong, we'll ____ Thailand and Vietnam.
words.ex3_en: It took her hours to make her way to the airport in heavy traffic.
words.ex3_zh: 在嚴重的塞車中，她花了好幾個小時才到達機場。
words.ex3_blank: It took her hours to ____ the airport in heavy traffic.
words.grammar: one's 要換成跟主詞一致的所有格（my/your/his/her/our/their），例如 made our way to、make her way to。

words.ex_en: Even though Nick is retired, he always tries to stay active.
words.ex_zh: 儘管尼克已退休了，但他總是保持活躍。
words.ex_blank: ____ Nick is retired, he always tries to stay active.
words.ex2_en: Even though we are traveling around the world, we'll have to pick and choose based on budget.
words.ex2_zh: 雖然我們是要環遊世界，但我們還是得依預算來挑選地點。
words.ex2_blank: ____ we are traveling around the world, we'll have to pick and choose based on budget.
words.ex3_en: Even though it was raining, hundreds of tourists still visited the temple.
words.ex3_zh: 儘管當時正在下雨，還是有數百名遊客造訪了這座寺廟。
words.ex3_blank: ____ it was raining, hundreds of tourists still visited the temple.
words.grammar: even though 後面要接完整子句（主詞+動詞），語氣比 though 強；不要跟表示假設的 even if 搞混。

words.ex_en: Backpackers often choose to stay in a hostel to save money.
words.ex_zh: 背包客通常會選擇住青年旅館以省錢。
words.ex_blank: Backpackers often choose to stay in a ____ to save money.

words.ex_en: A capsule hotel gives you just enough space to sleep in a small pod.
words.ex_zh: 膠囊旅館只提供一個小艙位，剛好夠你睡覺的空間。
words.ex_blank: A ____ gives you just enough space to sleep in a small pod.

words.ex_en: She did a workaway on a farm in exchange for free meals and a bed.
words.ex_zh: 她在一個農場打工換宿，換取免費三餐和住宿。
words.ex_blank: She did a ____ on a farm in exchange for free meals and a bed.

words.zh: 沙發衝浪（借住在別人家裡）
words.ex_en: Couchsurfing let him stay with locals for free during his trip.
words.ex_zh: 沙發衝浪讓他在旅途中能免費借宿在當地人家裡。
words.ex_blank: ____ let him stay with locals for free during his trip.

words.ex_en: They agreed to do house-sitting for their neighbors over the summer.
words.ex_zh: 他們答應在暑假期間幫鄰居看房子。
words.ex_blank: They agreed to do ____ for their neighbors over the summer.
